prompt: Create a cinematic high-fashion fantasy portrait of a young androgynous elf-like model centered against a plain dark gray studio background. The subject has very pale porcelain skin, faint freckles across the nose and cheeks, sleepy half-lidded eyes, white eyebrows and lashes, subtle reddish lips, and large pointed ears protruding from the sides of the head. Dress them in an oversized sculptural hood and cloak made from pale icy blue-gray crumpled satin or paperlike fabric with faint marbled gold flecks. The hood forms a dramatic wide triangular silhouette with two long horizontal horn-like points extending left and right, framing the face in an oval opening; the material is wrinkled, padded, organic, and slightly weathered. Around the neck is a bulky gathered collar tied at the center with a small dark clasp, with soft folds cascading downward and a narrow glimpse of bare chest beneath. Use soft diffused studio lighting from the front-left, gentle shadowing, muted cool color grading, shallow depth of field, ultra-detailed skin texture and fabric fibers, editorial couture styling, surreal fantasy realism, calm melancholic expression, symmetrical frontal composition, waist-up crop, no text, no jewelry except the small dark clasp, no busy background.

promptZh: 创作一张电影级的高级定制奇幻肖像，主体为 一位年轻的中性化精灵模特，居中置于纯深灰色摄影棚背景前。主体拥有极其苍白的瓷器般皮肤，鼻梁和脸颊上有淡淡的雀斑，眼神慵懒微闭，眉毛和睫毛呈白色，嘴唇微红，头部两侧长有巨大的尖耳朵。为模特穿上一件超大号的雕塑感兜帽和斗篷，材质为 淡冰蓝灰色褶皱缎面或纸质面料，带有淡淡的大理石纹金色斑点。兜帽形成戏剧性的宽三角形轮廓，左右两侧延伸出两个长长的水平角状尖端，将面部框在椭圆形的开口中；材质呈现出褶皱、填充、有机且略带风化的质感。颈部周围是一个厚实的褶皱领，中心用一个小巧的深色扣子系住，柔软的褶皱向下垂落，隐约可见下方裸露的胸部。使用来自左前方的柔和漫射摄影棚灯光，营造柔和的阴影，采用低饱和度的冷色调，浅景深，呈现超细腻的皮肤纹理和织物纤维，具备编辑级高定风格、超现实奇幻写实感、平静忧郁的表情、对称的正面构图、半身剪裁，无文字，除小巧深色扣子外无任何珠宝，背景简洁。
